This pathway highlights a direct molecular interaction that could influence Slc6a4 function, potentially affecting neurotransmitter transport. Additionally, Atomoxetine is linked to Orgasm Abnormal through Vilazodone, which also binds to Slc6a4, suggesting a broader role in modulating Slc6a4 activity. The shared ancestry of Atomoxetine and Vilazodone in the category of Organic Aromatic Compounds further supports a common biological context. These findings collectively imply that Atomoxetine may influence Slc6a4 through multiple pathways, possibly by modulating neurotransmitter transport or other cellular processes, though the exact mechanism remains to be fully elucidated.
